definitions.explanation: A condition where a bone is displaced from its normal position at a joint.

examples.japanese: {転|ころ}んで{肩|かた}を{脱臼|だっきゅう}した。
examples.english: I fell and dislocated my shoulder.

examples.japanese: {脱臼|だっきゅう}は{早|はや}めに{治療|ちりょう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Dislocations need to be treated promptly.

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}の{脱臼|だっきゅう}は{痛|いた}いが{治|なお}りやすい。
examples.english: A dislocated finger is painful but heals easily.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{脱臼|だっきゅう}する (to dislocate)
・{脱臼|だっきゅう}を{起|お}こす (to suffer a dislocation)
・{脱臼|だっきゅう}を{治|なお}す (to fix/reduce a dislocation)
・{肩|かた}の{脱臼|だっきゅう} (shoulder dislocation)
・{顎|あご}の{脱臼|だっきゅう} (jaw dislocation)

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
・{骨折|こっせつ} (bone fracture)
・{捻挫|ねんざ} (sprain)
・{打撲|だぼく} (bruise/contusion)
